faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Research Associate III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Research Associate III post at AIIMS Delhi is 23rd August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate III position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MD/MS/MPH/MDS from a recognized medical/dental college or an MSc/PhD in Life Sciences with relevant experience in systematic reviews and meta-analysis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate III post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate III position is 35 years, with age relaxation applicable as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate III role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 67,000 to Rs. 87,100 per month, including HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the AIIMS Delhi Research Associate III job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official AIIMS Delhi website on or before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Associate III position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Personal Discussion followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Research Associate III position at AIIMS Delhi is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Associate III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Research Associate III post at AIIMS Delhi.
